```{r setup}
library(actR)
```

### Build a synthetic time series with a shift in mean

The time series will have 300 time steps, on a yr BP axis from 0 to 299 yr BP. `makeShift()` puts the shift 65 steps from the start of the series, and since the series runs forward in time (from old to young), the mean rises by 0.5 at about 235 yr BP.

```{r}
syntheticTransition <- makeShift(length = 300, amp=0.5, start = 65,
                                 time.units = "yr BP")
```

### Detect Shift

we will test the synthetic time series with `detectShift`

```{r}
synTrans <- detectShift(syntheticTransition,
                     null.hypothesis.n = 50,
                     summary.bin.step = 1,
                     minimum.segment.length = 50,
                     simulate.time.uncertainty = FALSE,
                     method = "AMOC",
                     cpt.fun = changepoint::cpt.mean,
                     paleo.uncertainty = 0.1,
                     n.ens = 50)
```


###Plot shift

Let's plot the results

```{r}

plotShift(synTrans)

```
